equity.level_reason: Screening percentages are reported and described across three family-income groups, with a rising gradient, but no difference is computed and no disparity is framed. Because the values are only set side by side, the level is capped at 2.

equity.equity_measurement: Family income is categorized as percent of FPL, with imputation when income is missing; no counts or share missing are reported, and only 2021 is shown.

notes: The income groups are described with three side-by-side percentages and no computed difference or test, so the comparison scale is null and equity stays at level 2. No model, test or weighting is stated; CIs appear only as figure error bars with no method given. Mammography is coded as cancer (breast cancer screening), and family-income imputation is a data-handling rule, not a procedure.
view_issues: No CSV table was supplied, so the income-group values come from the text only; bar values beyond the text were not read.
